components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:

      properties:

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

## Summary

Added optional owner `email` support: when present it must be a syntactically valid address, and it is stored and returned lower-cased; when present but invalid the request is rejected with 400. Missing/blank email is accepted.

Changes, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions:

- **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `email` string property to the `OwnerFields` schema (not in `required`). This regenerates `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` with an `email` field, so it round-trips through the mapper and appears in the GET response.
- **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`) with getter/setter. MapStruct maps it by name automatically.
- **Schemas** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — added the `email` column to the `owners` table.
- **Seed data** (`db/{hsqldb,mysql}/data.sql`) — the positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)` rows would otherwise fail with a column-count mismatch, so appended a `NULL` email to each (h2/postgres already use explicit column lists).
- **New function `NormalizeOwnerEmail`** — treats null/blank as absent; validates a present value against an email regex, throwing `InvalidEmailException` (checked) on failure; otherwise lower-cases and writes it back onto the validated body in place.
- **New escalation** — `InvalidEmailException` + `InvalidEmailHandler` + escalation YAML, producing a 400 `ProblemDetail` naming `email` in the `errors` array, mirroring the existing telephone handler.
- **Wiring** — inserted a `normalizeEmail` step into `owners.POST.yml` (after telephone normalization) and, for consistency, into `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` after validation, with `ApplyOwner` now setting `email` on update.

Verified: `Cp04Tests` (lowercasing, invalid rejection, missing-email acceptance) and the full suite pass — 10/10 green.

Note: the JDBC repository profile (`JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl`) isn't exercised by the tests (they run under `spring-data-jpa`) and I left its hand-written SQL untouched; if that profile is ever used, its owner insert/update statements would need the `email` column added to actually persist the value there.
